tasks.label: check: current file
tasks.detail: ruff + basedpyright on the open .pyn, .py or .ipynb, through byname tool (byname notebooks translated)
tasks.command: F=$(echo '${file}' | cut -d'#' -f1); echo "checking $F"; echo; case "$F" in *.pyn|*.py|*.ipynb) ;; *) echo 'not a .pyn, .py or .ipynb file'; exit 0;; esac; echo '─── ruff ───'; uv run byname tool ruff check --output-format=concise "$F" && echo '✅ ruff ok'; echo; echo '─── basedpyright ───'; uv run byname tool basedpyright "$F" && echo '✅ basedpyright ok'; echo
